result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading indicator is visibly overlaid on restaurant imagery.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant image, obscuring the food photo and making the card look unfinished or stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the restaurant image has loaded, or show a dedicated skeleton/loading placeholder until the image is ready.
